scope: Exploratory offline extension of the completed GPU action-change screen. No neural inference or simulator use.
hypothesis: Adding the current absolute joint position to the previously tested baseline-minus-hold affine correction may explain task-general fine-tuning changes.
fit: Unregularized weighted least squares per 21 non-gripper coordinates; no hyperparameter selection. Training-only centering and RMS scaling.
weights: Equal tasks, then equal samples within task, then equal valid prefix positions within sample.
evaluation: Leave one of three complete tasks out. Same first min(16,H) valid positions as prior audit, including short boundary samples.
summaries: Per coordinate dimensionless explained fraction relative to zero correction. Macro mean per group; also wins over both zero and prior affine.
limits: 36 selected training-seen anchors in 9 episodes; exploratory rather than confirmatory.
Highly correlated samples and possible ill-conditioned extrapolation; report ranks and coefficients.
No closed-loop or physical-benefit interpretation from regression fit.
